facts.fact: CRAN issued Starlink a cease-and-desist order for operating a network in Namibia without the required telecommunications licence, and said it had confiscated terminals from consumers and opened criminal cases (statement issued the day before the 2024-12-01 article).
CRAN said Starlink's application for a telecommunications service licence was still under review, and that until a licence is granted importing Starlink terminals and using its service is illegal.
